charts.title: HAT-P-19 b: orbits around HAT-P-19
charts.description: The orbits of HAT-P-19's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HAT-P-19 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kang et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.528.1930K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KANG_ET_AL_2024): P 4.00878322 d

charts.title: HAT-P-19 b: its transit
charts.description: HAT-P-19 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (57, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 267650535, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 11-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
